title.en: Guest house: from listing to the guests who find you
title.af: Gastehuis: van advertensie tot die gaste wat jou vind
title.zu: Indlu yezivakashi: kusukela esikhangisweni kuya ezivakashini ezikutholayo
title.xh: Indlu yeendwendwe: ukusuka kwintengiso ukuya kwiindwendwe ezikufumanayo
title.nso: Ntlo ya baeng: go tloga papatšong go ya go baeng bao ba go hwetšago

chapters.nso: Tsenya lefelo la gago la go robala

en: Tap [[Sell]], then [[Adventures]]
In TrustSquare tap [[Sell]] at the bottom and choose [[Adventures]].
af: Tik [[Sell]], dan [[Adventures]]
Tik in TrustSquare onder op [[Sell]] en kies [[Adventures]].
zu: Thepha [[Sell]], bese [[Adventures]]
Ku-TrustSquare thepha [[Sell]] ngezansi bese ukhetha [[Adventures]].
xh: Cofa [[Sell]], emva koko [[Adventures]]
Kwi-TrustSquare cofa [[Sell]] ezantsi uze ukhethe [[Adventures]].
nso: Kgotla [[Sell]], ke moka [[Adventures]]
Go TrustSquare kgotla [[Sell]] ka fase gomme o kgethe [[Adventures]].

en: Pick [[Accommodation]]
Stays are guest houses, bush camps, chalets, hostels, self-catering places, camp sites and huts. Experiences are things people do.
af: Kies [[Accommodation]]
Verblyf is gastehuise, boskampe, chalets, hostelle, selfsorg-plekke, kampeerterreine en hutte. Ervarings is dinge wat mense doen.
zu: Khetha [[Accommodation]]
Izindawo zokuhlala yizindlu zezivakashi, amakamu asehlathini, ama-chalet, amahostela, izindawo ozipheka kuzo, izindawo zokukhempa namaqhugwana. Okuhlangenwe nakho yizinto abantu abazenzayo.
xh: Khetha [[Accommodation]]
Iindawo zokuhlala zizindlu zeendwendwe, iinkampu zasehlathini, ii-chalet, iihostele, iindawo ozipheka kuzo, iindawo zokukhempisha neendlwana. Amava zizinto abantu abazenzayo.
nso: Kgetha [[Accommodation]]
Mafelo a go robala ke dintlo tša baeng, dikampa tša sekgwa, di-chalet, di-hostele, mafelo a go iphepa, mafelo a go kampa le mapotlana. Maitemogelo ke dilo tšeo batho ba di dirago.

en: Add your best photos
Start with the outside or the view, then a room. The app checks every photo and blurs signs and street numbers, so your exact address stays private.
af: Voeg jou beste foto's by
Begin met die buitekant of die uitsig, dan 'n kamer. Die toep kyk na elke foto en maak borde en straatnommers dof, sodat jou presiese adres privaat bly.
zu: Engeza izithombe zakho ezinhle kakhulu
Qala ngangaphandle noma ngombono, bese kuba igumbi. I-app ihlola zonke izithombe futhi ifiphaze izimpawu nezinombolo zomgwaqo, ukuze ikheli lakho eliqondile lihlale liyimfihlo.
xh: Yongeza iifoto zakho ezilungileyo
Qala ngangaphandle okanye ngembonakalo, emva koko igumbi. I-app ihlola yonke ifoto ize ifiphaze iimpawu neenombolo zesitalato, ukuze idilesi yakho ichaneke ihlale iyimfihlo.
nso: Oketša diswantšho tša gago tše dibotse
Thoma ka ka ntle goba pono, ke moka kamora. App e hlahloba seswantšho se sengwe le se sengwe gomme e fifatša matšhwao le dinomoro tša mebila, gore aterese ya gago ya nnete e dule e le sephiri.

en: Say what kind of stay it is
Choose the type, then the rooms, how many it sleeps, your star grading, your price a night and your area.
af: Sê watter soort verblyf dit is
Kies die soort, dan die kamers, hoeveel dit slaap, jou stergradering, jou prys per nag en jou area.
zu: Yisho ukuthi kuyindawo enjani yokuhlala
Khetha uhlobo, bese amagumbi, bangaki abangalala khona, izinkanyezi zakho, intengo yakho ngobusuku nendawo yakho.
xh: Yitsho ukuba yindawo enjani yokuhlala
Khetha uhlobo, emva koko amagumbi, bangaphi abanokulala apho, iinkwenkwezi zakho, ixabiso lakho ngobusuku nendawo yakho.
nso: Bolela gore ke lefelo la mohuta ofe
Kgetha mohuta, ke moka dikamora, ba bakae bao ba ka robalago moo, dinaledi tša gago, theko ya gago ka bošego le lefelo la gago.

en: Answer the house rules once
Meals, pets and children, and a few words about what makes a stay special. Guests stop asking the same questions.
af: Beantwoord die huisreëls een keer
Etes, troeteldiere en kinders, en 'n paar woorde oor wat 'n verblyf spesiaal maak. Gaste hou op om dieselfde vrae te vra.
zu: Phendula imithetho yendlu kanye
Ukudla, izilwane ezifuywayo nezingane, namagama ambalwa ngokwenza ukuhlala kukhethekile. Izivakashi ziyayeka ukubuza imibuzo efanayo.
xh: Phendula imithetho yendlu kanye
Ukutya, izilwanyana zasekhaya nabantwana, namazwi ambalwa ngokwenza ukuhlala kukhethekile. Iindwendwe ziyayeka ukubuza imibuzo efanayo.
nso: Araba melao ya ntlo gatee
Dijo, diruiwa le bana, le mantšu a mmalwa ka seo se dirago gore go dula moo go be go kgethegilego. Baeng ba tlogela go botšiša dipotšišo tše di swanago.

en: Say where it is and what is around it
Type the general area and pick the [[Environment]]: bush, mountains, coast, farm and more. Guests search by it.
af: Sê waar dit is en wat rondom dit is
Tik die algemene area en kies die [[Environment]]: bosveld, berge, kus, plaas en meer. Gaste soek daarvolgens.
zu: Yisho ukuthi ikuphi nokuthi yini ezungezile
Bhala indawo ngokujwayelekile bese ukhetha [[Environment]]: ihlathi, izintaba, ugu, ipulazi nokunye. Izivakashi zisesha ngakho.
xh: Yitsho ukuba iphi kwaye yintoni ejikelezileyo
Bhala indawo ngokubanzi uze ukhethe [[Environment]]: ihlathi, iintaba, unxweme, ifama nokunye. Iindwendwe zikhangela ngako.
nso: Bolela gore le kae le gore go na le eng go le dikologa
Ngwala lefelo ka kakaretšo gomme o kgethe [[Environment]]: sekgwa, dithaba, lebopo, polase le tše dingwe. Baeng ba nyaka ka yona.

en: Tick your features
[[Pool]], [[Braai]], [[WiFi]], [[Fireplace]] and the rest. They make your listing richer.
af: Merk jou geriewe
[[Pool]], [[Braai]], [[WiFi]], [[Fireplace]] en die res. Hulle maak jou advertensie ryker.
zu: Maka izinto onazo
[[Pool]], [[Braai]], [[WiFi]], [[Fireplace]] nokunye. Zenza isikhangiso sakho sicebe kakhudlwana.
xh: Phawula izinto onazo
[[Pool]], [[Braai]], [[WiFi]], [[Fireplace]] nokunye. Zenza intengiso yakho ityebe ngakumbi.
nso: Swaya dilo tšeo o nago le tšona
[[Pool]], [[Braai]], [[WiFi]], [[Fireplace]] le tše dingwe. Di dira gore papatšo ya gago e humile.

en: Read the legal side
Zoning, fire safety, a guest register and insurance: what a host needs in South Africa. It is general guidance, not legal advice.
af: Lees die regskant
Sonering, brandveiligheid, 'n gasteregister en versekering: wat 'n gasheer in Suid-Afrika nodig het. Dit is algemene riglyne, nie regsadvies nie.
zu: Funda uhlangothi lwezomthetho
Ukuklanywa komhlaba, ukuphepha emlilweni, irejista yezivakashi nomshwalense: lokho umsingathi akudingayo eNingizimu Afrika. Kuyisiqondiso esijwayelekile, akusona iseluleko somthetho.
xh: Funda icala lomthetho
Ucando lomhlaba, ukhuseleko lomlilo, irejista yeendwendwe ne-inshorensi: oko umamkeli akufunayo eMzantsi Afrika. Sisikhokelo ngokubanzi, asiyongcebiso yomthetho.
nso: Bala lehlakore la molao
Karoganyo ya naga, polokego ya mollo, rejisetara ya baeng le inšorense: seo moamogedi a se hlokago ka Afrika Borwa. Ke tlhahlo ya kakaretšo, ga se keletšo ya molao.

en: Check your score and publish
Your score shows what would lift you higher in search. Tap [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]].
af: Kyk na jou telling en publiseer
Jou telling wys wat jou hoër in soektogte sal lig. Tik [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]].
zu: Bheka amaphuzu akho bese ushicilela
Amaphuzu akho akhombisa okungakuphakamisa ekusesheni. Thepha [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]].
xh: Jonga amanqaku akho uze upapashe
Amanqaku akho abonisa oko kunokukuphakamisa ekukhangeleni. Cofa [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]].
nso: Lebelela dintlha tša gago gomme o phatlalatše
Dintlha tša gago di bontšha seo se ka go phagamišago ka go nyakišišo. Kgotla [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]].

en: You are live
Guests can find you and ask for an introduction straight away. Upload your ID in [[My Space]], then [[Trust]], so they see you are checked.
af: Jy is lewendig
Gaste kan jou dadelik vind en vra vir 'n bekendstelling. Laai jou ID op in [[My Space]], dan [[Trust]], sodat hulle sien jy is nagegaan.
zu: Usuphilayo
Izivakashi zingakuthola futhi zicele ukwethulwa ngokushesha. Layisha i-ID yakho ku-[[My Space]], bese [[Trust]], ukuze zibone ukuthi uhloliwe.
xh: Uphilayo ngoku
Iindwendwe zingakufumana kwaye zicele ukwaziswa kwangoko. Layisha i-ID yakho kwi-[[My Space]], emva koko [[Trust]], ukuze zibone ukuba uhloliwe.
nso: O phela bjale
Baeng ba ka go hwetša gomme ba kgopela go tsebišwa gona bjale. Laiša ID ya gago go [[My Space]], ke moka [[Trust]], gore ba bone gore o hlahlobilwe.

en: A guest opens Adventures and taps [[Stays]]
She sees places to stay only, from guest houses to bush camps.
af: 'n Gas maak Adventures oop en tik [[Stays]]
Sy sien net blyplekke, van gastehuise tot boskampe.
zu: Isivakashi sivula i-Adventures bese sithepha [[Stays]]
Sibona izindawo zokuhlala kuphela, kusukela ezindlini zezivakashi kuya emakamu asehlathini.
xh: Undwendwe luvula i-Adventures luze lucofe [[Stays]]
Lubona iindawo zokuhlala kuphela, ukusuka kwizindlu zeendwendwe ukuya kwiinkampu zasehlathini.
nso: Moeng o bula Adventures gomme o kgotla [[Stays]]
O bona mafelo a go dula feela, go tloga dintlong tša baeng go ya dikampeng tša sekgwa.

en: She picks the surroundings she wants
In [[Filtered Search]] she taps an [[Environment]], like [[Farm & Rural]], then [[Show results]].
af: Sy kies die omgewing wat sy wil hê
In [[Filtered Search]] tik sy 'n [[Environment]], soos [[Farm & Rural]], dan [[Show results]].
zu: Sikhetha indawo esiyifunayo
Ku-[[Filtered Search]] sithepha i-[[Environment]], njenge-[[Farm & Rural]], bese [[Show results]].
xh: Lukhetha indawo olufuna yona
Kwi-[[Filtered Search]] lucofa i-[[Environment]], njenge-[[Farm & Rural]], emva koko [[Show results]].
nso: O kgetha tikologo yeo a e nyakago
Go [[Filtered Search]] o kgotla [[Environment]], bjalo ka [[Farm & Rural]], ke moka [[Show results]].

en: Your stay is there
Your card says [[Stays]] and your environment. She can also type your town in the search box.
af: Jou verblyf is daar
Jou kaart sê [[Stays]] en jou omgewing. Sy kan ook jou dorp in die soekblokkie tik.
zu: Indawo yakho ikhona
Ikhadi lakho lithi [[Stays]] kanye nendawo ekuzungezile. Angabhala nedolobha lakho ebhokisini lokusesha.
xh: Indawo yakho ikhona
Ikhadi lakho lithi [[Stays]] kunye nendawo ekujikelezileyo. Unokubhala nedolophu yakho kwibhokisi yokukhangela.
nso: Lefelo la gago le gona
Karata ya gago e re [[Stays]] le tikologo ya gago. A ka ngwala le toropo ya gago lebokoseng la go nyaka.

en: She reads your listing
Your price a night, your area, your environment, your rules and your Trust Score. Your name and address stay private.
af: Sy lees jou advertensie
Jou prys per nag, jou area, jou omgewing, jou reëls en jou Trust Score. Jou naam en adres bly privaat.
zu: Sifunda isikhangiso sakho
Intengo yakho ngobusuku, indawo yakho, okukuzungezile, imithetho yakho ne-Trust Score yakho. Igama lakho nekheli lakho kuhlala kuyimfihlo.
xh: Lufunda intengiso yakho
Ixabiso lakho ngobusuku, indawo yakho, okukujikelezileyo, imithetho yakho ne-Trust Score yakho. Igama lakho nedilesi yakho zihlala ziyimfihlo.
nso: O bala papatšo ya gago
Theko ya gago ka bošego, lefelo la gago, tikologo ya gago, melao ya gago le Trust Score ya gago. Leina la gago le aterese di dula e le sephiri.

en: She asks for an introduction
She writes a short question. 1 Tuppence is held from her, and spent only if you accept.
af: Sy vra vir 'n bekendstelling
Sy skryf 'n kort vraag. 1 Tuppence word van haar teruggehou en net bestee as jy aanvaar.
zu: Sicela ukwethulwa
Sibhala umbuzo omfushane. I-Tuppence e-1 iyabanjwa kuso, isetshenziswe kuphela uma wamukela.
xh: Lucela ukwaziswa
Lubhala umbuzo omfutshane. I-Tuppence e-1 iyabanjwa kulo, isetyenziswe kuphela ukuba uyamkela.
nso: O kgopela go tsebišwa
O ngwala potšišo ye kopana. Tuppence e 1 e swarwa go yena, e šomišwa feela ge o amogela.

en: Read her question
Open [[My Space]], then [[Intros]]. Her message shows under her request.
af: Lees haar vraag
Maak [[My Space]] oop, dan [[Intros]]. Haar boodskap wys onder haar versoek.
zu: Funda umbuzo wakhe
Vula [[My Space]], bese [[Intros]]. Umlayezo wakhe uvela ngaphansi kwesicelo sakhe.
xh: Funda umbuzo wakhe
Vula [[My Space]], emva koko [[Intros]]. Umyalezo wakhe uvela phantsi kwesicelo sakhe.
nso: Bala potšišo ya gagwe
Bula [[My Space]], ke moka [[Intros]]. Molaetša wa gagwe o tšwelela ka fase ga kgopelo ya gagwe.

en: Accept
Tap [[Accept]]. It costs you nothing. You both get an email: reply to it to talk. Your email address stays private.
af: Aanvaar
Tik [[Accept]]. Dit kos jou niks. Julle albei kry 'n e-pos: antwoord dit om te praat. Jou e-posadres bly privaat.
zu: Yamukela
Thepha [[Accept]]. Akukubizi lutho. Nobabili nithola i-imeyili: yiphendule ukuze nikhulume. Ikheli lakho le-imeyili lihlala liyimfihlo.
xh: Yamkela
Cofa [[Accept]]. Akukuxabisi nto. Nobabini nifumana i-imeyile: yiphendule ukuze nithethe. Idilesi yakho ye-imeyile ihlala iyimfihlo.
nso: Amogela
Kgotla [[Accept]]. Ga go go biditše selo. Ka bobedi le hwetša imeile: e arabe gore le boledišane. Aterese ya gago ya imeile e dula e le sephiri.

en: She sees you accepted
Her [[Intros]] say [[Accepted]], and her 1 Tuppence is spent.
af: Sy sien jy het aanvaar
Haar [[Intros]] sê [[Accepted]], en haar 1 Tuppence is bestee.
zu: Sibona ukuthi wamukele
Ama-[[Intros]] aso athi [[Accepted]], futhi i-Tuppence yaso e-1 isisetshenzisiwe.
xh: Lubona ukuba wamkele
Ii-[[Intros]] zalo zithi [[Accepted]], kwaye i-Tuppence yalo e-1 isetyenzisiwe.
nso: O bona gore o amogetše
Di-[[Intros]] tša gagwe di re [[Accepted]], gomme Tuppence ya gagwe e 1 e šomišitšwe.

en: Put your stay on your WhatsApp Status
In your [[Seller Hub]] tap [[Share to Status]]. A card with your stay, your price and your link opens: save it and post it.
af: Sit jou verblyf op jou WhatsApp Status
Tik in jou [[Seller Hub]] op [[Share to Status]]. 'n Kaart met jou verblyf, jou prys en jou skakel maak oop: stoor dit en plaas dit.
zu: Beka indawo yakho ku-WhatsApp Status yakho
Ku-[[Seller Hub]] yakho thepha [[Share to Status]]. Kuvuleka ikhadi elinendawo yakho, intengo yakho nesixhumanisi sakho: lilondoloze bese ulifaka.
xh: Beka indawo yakho kwi-WhatsApp Status yakho
Kwi-[[Seller Hub]] yakho cofa [[Share to Status]]. Kuvuleka ikhadi elinendawo yakho, ixabiso lakho nekhonkco lakho: ligcine uze ulifake.
nso: Bea lefelo la gago go WhatsApp Status ya gago
Go [[Seller Hub]] ya gago kgotla [[Share to Status]]. Karata ye e nago le lefelo la gago, theko ya gago le kgokagano ya gago e a bulega: e boloke gomme o e tsenye.
